notes.title: Patch Notes — Update #3
notes.notes:
Thank you again for your patience as we work to release updates to Pixelshire. We're happy to share the third patch is now live!


Patch Notes


Gameplay Changes:

• Added a Toolbar system

• Removed the Tool Durability system

• Deconstructed items are now transparent

• NPCs can no longer follow the player into houses

 

Compendium Updates:

• Updated entries for toolbar, durability, and repair

• Disabled the Repair tab

 

Quest & Item Fixes:

• Rubber Plant (main quest item) can no longer be gifted to NPCs

• Fixed the Zucchini crop withering after passing the day

 

Visual Fixes:

• Fixed chest loot clipping / hiding behind cave nodes

notes.title: Patch Notes — Update #2
notes.notes:
https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/42496463/48ff3ee8d1298e16b0453759ec42b6ce68414d46.png

Again, please note that this is the second in a series of upcoming patches. We continue working to implement player feedback, improve the game, and fix bugs!

Here are just some of the exciting changes in today's update. You can find the full patch notes below.

🍂🌸 Added Fall and Spring seasons
☀️❄️ Seasons are now 30 days long
🎣 A more forgiving fishing experience
🥳 Updated NPC birthdays
🔨 Hammer can now be used everywhere
-☘️ Dirt count removed
-🗺️ Live map



General
• Fixed bug where loading couldn’t start in certain languages after finishing the game.
• Fixed issue where some tiles were missing in the desert.
• Fixed chest sorting and exit panel causing the inventory to stop responding.
• Fixed Greek translation for stone tiles.
• Fixed shadows for some decorative trees at the map boundaries.
• Fixed issue where gifting cake on a birthday wasn’t working correctly.
• Fixed tree animations in the town area.
• Fixed issue where the player could destroy the Moonstone before using it for crafting. It can now only be destroyed in the next stage.
• Fixed blocker where saving and quitting during an objective in Dead Man's Chest caused the quest to break at the end.
• Fixed issue where completing the "Cobalt, Gold, and Ice Crystals" quest for Nina gave two blueprints.
• Fixed issue where Fig tree seeds wouldn’t stack.
• Fixed bug where planting Lemon/Fig/Apple/Cherry seeds in grass would result in an immediately fully grown tree.
• Fixed lack of tooltip when attempting to accept more than the max number of side quests.
• Fixed issue where saving into the next day during "Find Someone in Pixelshire" caused villagers to spawn outside.
• Fixed issue with replacing indoor lamps with round lamps not working properly on load.
• Fixed issue where all NPCs gathered in the Town Hall after sleeping at the end of the game.
• Fixed issue where selling items to shops gave incorrect value (now properly set to 30% less than buy price).
• Fixed issue with shop warning messages not appearing when you don’t have enough money or when stack is full.
• Fixed bug where planting twice in the same spot could result in losing seeds.
• Fixed issue where talking to Saint did not give the player the blueprint to build his house.
• Removed chair from the fishing loot table.
• Fixed issues with the Blacksmith and Scroll tutorials.
• Silvert and Iowa quests now display correctly.
• Fixed issue where exclamation marks disappeared for crafted items after passing the day.
• Fixed issue where the Rainbow Lobster disappeared after quitting the game.
• Fixed issue where the interaction button and fishing minigame button overlapped, allowing unintended fish egg collection mid-minigame.
• Removed interior and exterior conditions for fishing
• Removed seasonal conditions for fishing
• Fixed fishing animation
• Fixed rope visuals during fishing
• Changed sound when catching fish
• Fixed issue where the player's animation could get stuck after fishing
• Fixed inconsistent fishing behavior when standing above fish eggs
• Fixed Iowas and Sivert main quests
• Fixed fence doors not updating the pathfinding grid
• Fixed issue where the rubber plant given by Eva could be destroyed
• Fixed issue with two button inputs appearing near rice crops

UI & Inventory
• Enabled sorting buttons on chests.
• Added a Live Map panel of Pixelshire
• Removed dirt count display

Seasons & Time
• Added Fall and Spring seasons (WIP).
• Changed season Length to 31 days.
• Shortened daytime slightly.

Housing & Environment
• 🪧 Removed red rag from the house.

NPCs & Relationships
• Gifting cake on a birthday now boosts friendship as intended.

Plants & Seasons
• Changed plant growing seasons.
• Updated translations for plant seasons.
• Added translations for new season names: Fall and Spring.

Gameplay Changes
• Changed dialogue system so that dialogue indices are now untied from item rewards—dialogue errors will no longer block items being given.
• Quicker tool actions implemented for smoother gameplay.
• Increased the time before losing fish and decreased rotation speed for a more forgiving fishing experience.
• 🪙 Sell price grade multiplier increased from 20% to 25%.
• Reduced seed rewards from the Fertilizer quest.

Systems & Features
• Items placed on museum pedestals are now saved in the save file.
• Added tutorials for Blacksmithing and Scrolls.

Shops & Resources
• 🪙 Bron now always spawns: Stone, Iron Ores, Copper Ores, and Coal Ores.
• Changed from 4 to 10 Iron Ores given by Bron to help players upgrade their pickaxe without needing to purchase ores/bars.
• All fish eggs have been added to Cpt. Farrell’s standard shop.
• Removed the duplicate shovel from Farrell’s shop.

Farming & Tools
• Reduced water usage from 5 to 3 per use with the watering can.
• Added warning when trying to use the watering can without enough water.
• The hammer can now be used everywhere.

Quests & Objectives
• Changed several quest objectives and descriptions for clarity and consistency.
• Increased the size of quest tabs in the player menu to support longer quest names without text being cut off.


Other Known Issues:
• Berries on bushes don’t respawn during the winter.
• Can’t replace hay trough unless player exits to main menu.
• If player accepts sidequest while having the required materials, the adjacent sidequest will not be acceptable.

notes.title: Update #2 Comes Next Week
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

Pixelshire's second Update needs a little more time to cook, so we will release it next week. We are working diligently to implement player feedback, improve the game, and fix bugs each week, but sometimes we need more time to do this correctly. 

Thank you for your continued patience and support as we work to incorporate your suggestions, and as we move forward with future patches! We look forward to exploring new features and improvements as Pixelshire continues to evolve.

We’re committed to improving Pixelshire and truly appreciate your continued support and feedback!

Here are a few of the changes that you can expect in Update #2.


 Changed season Length to 30 days. 
 Fixed issue where the player could destroy the Moonstone before using it for crafting. It can now only be destroyed in the next stage. 
 Quicker tool actions implemented for smoother gameplay. 
 Increased the time before losing fish and decreased rotation speed for a more forgiving fishing experience. 
 Added warning when trying to use the watering can without enough water. 
 The hammer can now be used everywhere.

notes.title: Hotfix #1 is Live!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

Pixelshire's first Hotfix is officially live! 

Before we get into the details, it's important to note that this is the first in a series of upcoming patches. We are working diligently to implement player feedback, improve the game, and fix bugs! 

Here are some changes in today's update. You can find the full patch notes below. 

🌊 The ability to fill the watering can at any water source
🛠️ Tool changes such as repairing tools below epic rarity now costs 0 coins
☀️❄️ Seasons are now 15 days long
🖥️ An option to disable screen shake
🛒 Shop changes

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42496463/c650964efee6695d1714a85f2dfd5abec59bf76b.gif
Watering can update

Here is a list of some additional features we're currently working on and exploring:

🍂💮 More seasons (currently in progress)

🔧 Tooltip on world objects

🎮 Control rebinding

🔧 A toolbar

🗒️ A crafting material tracker

🔎 An option to zoom out or add a dedicated screenshot option

✔️ And much more

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42496463/24a500aed8a757ca31a1b38841d05a109361a9ec.gif
Free tool repair

You might notice that we switched to a more popular control layout and updated all of the button callouts in the game. Let us know if you find any that we may have missed.

Thank you for your continued patience and support as we work to incorporate your suggestions, and as we move forward with future patches! We look forward to exploring new features and improvements as Pixelshire continues to evolve. 

We’re committed to improving Pixelshire and truly appreciate your continued support and feedback!


Patch Notes

🔨 Tool & Equipment Changes

 Tools can no longer be trashed until you complete Stage 22 or if they have zero durability.
 Copper tools can no longer be dropped or destroyed until Stage 33.
 Repairing tools below epic rarity now costs 0 coins.
 Added description in the Repair panel for wooden tools.


💧 Farming & Watering

 Watering can can now be refilled in any water tile, including dug holes.
 Added icon for refilling the watering can.
 Updated watered plant sprites for improved visual feedback.
 Water refill arrow in the pond has been relocated.
 Increased chances of obtaining seeds from bushes.
 Fountain can now be used to refill the watering can.


🛒 Shop & Economy

 Added warning in the shop when you don’t have enough coins.
 Added warning in the shop when your cart reaches the maximum stack limit.
 Added description in the shop panel for item rotation.


🛒 NPC Shop Updates

 Farrell now sells: Fishing Pole, Wooden Shovel
 Margarita now sells: Wooden Watering Can, Wooden Hoe
 Jack now sells: Wooden Axe
 Bron now sells: Wooden Pickaxe
 Valerie now sells: Wooden Sword
 Eva now sells: Wooden Hammer


🌿 Gameplay & Balance

 Items can no longer be consumed or spent if the relevant player stat is full.
 Reduced the number of flowers required for Cassandra’s main quest: Flora and Fauna.
 Reduced grass and tree spawn rates in the Glacial area.


✨ World & Gameplay Changes

 Seasons are now 15 days long. 
 Rocks in the mines now drop extra treasures.
 Added seashells to the Pixelshire Sea.
 New items added to digging and fishing loot tables.
 House can now only be built at the specific stage where you receive the material for it.
 Renamed Diffusion Stone to Moonstone.


🧙 Magic & Talents

 Incantation speed reduced from 1 to 0.5.
 Changed transparent background in talent description panel to allow selecting talents behind it.
 Added missing visual button for dodging in the Combat Lv3 Talent Tree.


🛠️  Controls & UI Changes

 Swapped buttons: Select and Buy.
 Tool action button changed from RT to X.
 Interaction button changed from X to A.
 Removed the Sorting button from the chests. We will re-enable it in a future build.


⚙️ Quality of Life

 Added screen shake option to settings.
 Updated Lucky Charm quest description.
 Removed Tinkle Chub from the Enchanted Fishing quest.
 Added text feedback showing stat gains when consuming food and taking damage.
 Added night warning to alert players as nighttime approaches.
 No visual button is shown for tool wheel prompt if no tool is selected.


✅ Bug Fixes

 Fixed issue where NPC sometimes does not follow the player.
 Fixed blocker where, if you load during the task to follow Nina back to the camp, she wouldn’t move.
 Fixed issue where Bron could go out of bounds.
 Fixed issue where Jack could get stuck out of bounds in the house.
 Fixed issue where typing in the Character Creator would change customization options.
 Fixed missing visual button for dodging in the Combat Lv3 Talent Tree.
 Fixed issue where closing the inventory with an item in hand prevented further actions.
 Fixed frame rate issues in the Glacial area.
 Fixed some NPC house doors not working properly.
 Fixed issue where unlimited items could not be purchased in the shop.
 Fixed issue where big rocks were not removed on loading after completing the tasks to break them.
 Fixed soft block caused by discarding tools before acquiring the workbench.
 Fixed issue where, after breaking rocks in Greenwood and inspecting the Moonstone, saving and quitting would cause the Moonstone to disappear.
 Fixed issue during The Altar main quest where the player could progress the questline by interacting with the altar without taking the Moonstone.
 Fixed warning when wooden tools are about to break.
 Fixed incorrect word “tomaste” appearing in the tutorial with Margarita when Spanish is selected.
 Fixed issue where watering plants with the watering can didn’t always work intuitively.
 Fixed issue where wood was removed from the item bag after completing the Chop Chop story mission.
 Fixed issue where rice seed could be removed by placing a pond tileset next to it with the shovel.
 Fixed fishing description.
 Fixed text in Blacksmith buttons (Upgrade & Repair).
 Fixed tool slot button in the Repair section.
 Fixed loading problems with Deadman's Chest stage.
 Fixed issue where the a Rusty Key could not be obtained if the fishing minigame was lost.
 Fixed issue where the Rusty Key could be deleted before Stage 43. (Changed so that quest progresses even if key is deleted)
 Fixed issue where selecting a scroll from the Incantation menu prevented selecting a new scroll within the same menu.
 Flowers and bushes outside Pixelshire can no longer be destroyed.
 Fixed bug where the player wouldn’t stop moving properly when using the sword.
 Fixed issue where exit app and exit to main menu dialogs were cut off.
 Sleeping while a bench is crafting will now correctly finish the crafting queue.
 Fixed issue where pressing X during Forge did not register input to clear slots.
 Fixed popup glyphs

notes.title: First Patch Releases This Friday
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, 

Quick update for you all. Our first patch for Pixelshire will release this Friday! We've heard your feedback, and once the update goes live, you'll be able to fill your watering can at any water source. We’ll share the full list of patch notes on Friday.

Right now, we're prioritizing fixing bugs and improving overall stability. In parallel, we're also working on implementing your suggestions—but please note that some of these will require more time and won't be added immediately.

Here are some of the improvements and features we're currently working on and exploring:

✅ The ability to fill the watering can at any water source

✅ Free tool repair

✅ An option to disable screen shake

🍂☀️🏖️ More seasons (currently in progress)

🔧 Tooltip on world objects

🎮 Control rebinding

🔧 A toolbar

🗒️ A crafting material tracker

🔎 An option to zoom out or add a dedicated screenshot option

✔️ And much more

We’re committed to improving Pixelshire and truly appreciate your continued support and feedback!

notes.title: First Patch Next Week + Update Schedule
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

We want to thank you all for supporting Pixelshire through the years. To everyone who’s been patient, supportive, or offered constructive feedback — thank you. It means so much to us. 

Launch has not gone the way we all had hoped, and we take full responsibility for that. After various playtests, we thought Pixelshire was in good shape to release, but clearly, we were wrong. In hindsight, it would have been better to stay with our original Early Access plan. 

That said, we want to focus on the future. We will keep working on Pixelshire, improving it, and supporting it for as long as it takes to create the best experience we can. Our first patch will be released next week, and then we will have weekly patches for May. In June, that cadence may change to every 1-2 weeks, depending on the size of the update. We'll also try to release smaller updates in between the patches if we can. Please remember that we are a small development team.

We’ll keep you updated as patches and improvements roll out. For next week's patch, we will share a full list of patch notes when the update goes live. 

Update Schedule:

 First Patch – Next Week
 May patches – Weekly
 Patches in June and on – Every 1-2 weeks is the current plan


We're here, we're listening, and we are determined to make this a game you can truly enjoy.

notes.title: Guide, FAQ and First Patch
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone, 

Thank you for all the valuable feedback you’ve shared so far. We are going through the forums and customer reviews to gather the issues submitted and collate them with our plans for Pixelshire’s first patch. We will release this initial patch next week, and as much as we’d love to, we cannot guarantee every issue will be addressed. 

It is obviously disheartening to see many of you are unhappy with the current gameplay experience and we will do everything we can to give you the version of Pixelshire that you wanted and deserve. We are working on putting together a schedule of planned updates and will share more details very soon. 

In the meantime, here is a how-to guide for the most pressing items, solutions to common bugs, some tips and tricks, and general game information. 

 GUIDE 

 How to refill a watering can: 

    Equip watering can
    Go to the west of Margarita’s house to the edge of the water with no fencing
    Hover cursor over the water and press E key / X on controller
    A watering well blueprint can be purchased from Magarita and after you build a well, you can use this as another source to refill your watering can


 Switching Tools: 

    Hold the Q key / LT on controller to open the tool wheel 
    Click on the tool you would like to use 
    Tool wheel prompt doesn’t show up if no tool is selected but the button still works. 


Tools become unusable if the durability is depleted (the bar at the bottom left side of the screen is completely empty):

    Craft or buy a new tool
    Go to the blacksmith NPC, Saint, and use his profession to repair your tool 


All seeds in shops replenish after sleeping:

    Sleeping can be done in the guest house next to Eva’s house
    Using the guest house can be done before its introduced to the player by Eva


Where to find higher tiers of ore

    Only 2 can be found in the Pixelshire mine near Bron
    More iron ore is found in the mine found in the Greenwood past where Saint is standing
    Bron gives you 4 iron ores to make the iron bars he requests 
    Each area will have a mine with higher tiers of ore


Each crop will have a description of what season they can grow in

Each Season is 10 days long. There are two seasons: Summer and Winter. 


 SOLUTIONS TO COMMON BUGS 

Q: Why can’t I buy more rice seeds?
If you bought all 6 rice seeds and there are no more rice seeds left in Margarita's shop, you need to sleep in the guest house which is the right-most door of the mayor's house (the big house above the fountain)!

Q: Where and how can I refill my watering can?
Be sure to target the square in front of you when refilling your can! The only place currently to fill your watering can is west of Margarita's house. The quest line will indicate this spot when you receive your watering can. 

Q: How can I move my work bench?
You will receive a hammer from the mayor that will allow you to change the placement of your work bench. 

Q: How do I dig a pond?
Dig in one spot until there is water. Repeat until there are 6 holes with water.

Q: How do I dig or elevate with the shovel?
There are three options with the shovel. You can see which option you have equipped by looking at above the tool icon in the bottom left corner when your character is holding the shovel. The three options are dig, add dirt to a hole or elevate the ground, and make slopes (LB if using a controller, R if using mouse and key). 


 GAME INFO 

Q: Are there any hardware & system requirements to run Pixelshire?
Pixelshire does not require high hardware performance and can guarantee a basic experience on most devices with core and set graphics.

Q: Can I play Pixelshire with a controller?
Yes, the game has full controller support.

Q: What languages does Pixelshire support?
Pixelshire supports English, German, Japanese, Portuguese, Spanish, French, Greek, and Simplified Chinese.

Q: Will the game support multiplayer co-op?
There are no plans for multiplayer at the moment.

Q: Does the game have achievements?
Yes, the game features a number of great achievements for players to unlock.

Q: How do I fix the UI scaling if it’s too big?
You can make any adjustments on the UI scaling bar under options. 

Q: Does Pixelshire support custom key binding?
At the moment, Pixelshire does not support custom key binding, but we are looking to add options in the future. 

 TIPS & TRICKS 

1. Collect excessive resources as soon as possible (i.e. wood, coal, and ores) because it makes the early game progress smoother.
2. Accept side quests as soon as you see them available from NPCs. They aren't always available.
3. Craft chests as soon as possible to store excess resources for later in the game. Remember to upgrade to Iron chests when possible.
4. Remember that seasons affect some crops so make sure to make the most of each season.
5. Gifts and side quests lead to romance and talents. Romance level leads to talent unlocks.
6. Harvest and water crops daily to get higher starred crops.
7. Try to not corner yourself while having an NPC follow you.
8. Compass doesn't tell you what area NPCs are in, so take note of where they like to go.

notes.title: Pixelshire Development Update – Road to Release!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We know many of you are eagerly awaiting news on Pixelshire’s release, and we truly appreciate your patience and support. Our goal is to launch sometime in Spring, but we’re not ready to lock in an exact date just yet.

Right now, our focus is on polishing the game, fixing remaining bugs, and refining gameplay mechanics to ensure that the experience is as smooth and enjoyable as possible. By the end of February, we’ll have a much clearer picture of where we stand and whether we're on track for the targeted release window.

We’re incredibly excited about how Pixelshire is shaping up, and we can’t wait to share more with you soon. Stay tuned for further updates as we approach the final stretch!

Thank you for being part of this journey with us!
